description: Analysis, modeling and simulation testbed for dynamic mobility applications is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Balaji Yelchuru, Raj Kishore Kamalanathsharma. Source: Provided by ITS DataHub (its.dot.gov/data) through the National Transportation Library. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The repository holds 6 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
